Starting OpenPDF…

The first start builds the background services and can take a few minutes; after that it takes seconds.

The background services are not answering yet. Make sure Podman (Linux) or Docker Desktop / Podman Desktop (Windows) is installed, then run this in the OpenPDF folder:

./scripts/start.sh (Linux)
powershell -File scripts\start.ps1 (Windows)

If the OpenPDF folder is not next to the app, set the environment variable OPENPDF_HOME to it. This window keeps waiting and opens the editor once the services are up.
